description: This file contains core utility functions and class definitions for Ext JS 3.4.0, including namespace management, type checking, DOM manipulation, event handling, AJAX, animations, and integration with YUI library components.

classes.name: Ext
classes.description: Singleton object providing core utilities, version info, namespace management, and feature detection.

classes.name: Ext.util.TaskRunner
classes.description: Class for executing multiple tasks in a multithreaded manner, with start, stop, and stopAll methods.

methods.name: Ext.apply
methods.description: Copies properties from source object to target object.

methods.name: Ext.applyIf
methods.description: Copies properties from source to target only if they are undefined in target.

methods.name: Ext.extend
methods.description: Creates a subclass of a class with optional overrides.

methods.name: Ext.override
methods.description: Overrides existing class methods with new implementations.

methods.name: Ext.getDom
methods.description: Returns the DOM element for a given id, element, or Ext.Element.

methods.name: Ext.get
methods.description: Returns an Ext.Element wrapper for a DOM element.

methods.name: Ext.fly
methods.description: Returns a flyweight Ext.Element for DOM manipulation.

methods.name: Ext.util.TaskRunner
methods.description: Class for managing and executing scheduled tasks.

methods.name: Ext.TaskMgr
